Build is clean — exit code 0, "0 errors". The remaining 8 warnings are just the deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()` constructor, punycode, etc.) baked into the bundler's output; those aren't causing failures.

The real issue was two bugs the dependency bump exposed, both in call sites that weren't updated for the bundler's new option shapes:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries` but the new bundler passes `retryCount`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, so it threw. Fixed to treat `undefined` as `false` (disabled).
